resources.string: Supports MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, FLAC, OGG, OPUS
M4A (AAC) creates smaller compressed files. WAV creates uncompressed 16-bit PCM for lossless editing.
Converting from a lossy format (e.g. MP3 to WAV) will not improve original audio quality, but creates a lossless representation.
Selected file contains no decodable audio
